Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
Tie(s) ::: s is a six-way tie.
From(x, y) ::: x is from y.
Leaderboard(y) ::: y is the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard y.
FromBelgium(x) ::: x is from Belgium.
Premises:
Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Participated(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (Tie(x) ∧ ∀y (OnLeaderboard(y, duMaurier1992) → Participated(y, duMaurier1992))) ::: There was one six-way tie on the leaderboard, and all participants were on the leaderboard.
∃x (FromBelgium(x) ∧ OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: Descampe is from Belgium and is on the leaderboard.
∃x (FromBelgium(x) ∧ OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Conclusion:
OnLeaderboard(Descampe, duMaurier1992) ∧ Tie(tie) ∧ ∀y (OnLeaderboard(y, duMaurier1992) → y ∈ tie) → Descampe is in the six-way tie in the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
